label: Mental Health
assignment: Discover realistic mental-health resources for people in {service_area}, from crisis response and urgent assessment through counseling, psychiatry, medication, peer support, and continuing care. Follow health systems and referral lines to specific programs while verifying clinical scope, age, payment, current appointments, crisis hours, language, accessibility, and the real intake path.
include: Crisis lines, mobile crisis, receiving centers, urgent assessment, and suicide-safety support
Counseling, psychiatry, medication management, groups, peer support, and case management
Community mental-health, Medicaid, uninsured, sliding-scale, school, and telehealth pathways
Services for children, families, trauma survivors, severe mental illness, perinatal needs, reentry, and co-occurring conditions
Hospital discharge, ongoing-care transitions, transportation, language, and disability access
exclude: Emergency services presented as routine continuing care without a follow-up pathway
Provider directories without verified availability, payer acceptance, or intake
Unlicensed wellness services presented as substitutes for needed clinical treatment
verificationQuestions: Is this crisis response, assessment, therapy, psychiatry, medication, peer support, or case management?
Which ages, diagnoses, acuity levels, insurance plans, or income groups are served?
Are appointments or crisis slots currently available and how long is the wait?
What happens after an urgent encounter or hospital discharge?

stages.title: Crisis and urgent response
stages.instruction: Investigate crisis calls and text, mobile response, receiving and stabilization centers, suicide-safety support, urgent assessment, after-hours access, transport, and the handoff into follow-up care.

stages.title: Counseling, psychiatry, and medication
stages.instruction: Investigate therapy, psychiatry, medication management, groups, case management, community mental-health, payer and sliding-scale options, waitlists, and referral requirements.

stages.title: Specialized and continuing support
stages.instruction: Investigate child, family, perinatal, trauma, severe-mental-illness, peer, school, reentry, co-occurring, multilingual, telehealth, and disability-accessible services.

stages.title: Continuity and availability review
stages.instruction: Cross-check current appointment access, age and acuity exclusions, payer acceptance, crisis-to-treatment handoffs, medication continuity, transport, language, and after-hours gaps. Distinguish licensed clinical care from general wellness support.
